ModMetaData.name: Niceties
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
My Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv Site (no Discord): https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/niceties
Small colony comforts vanilla never shipped. Niceties is one Harmony QoL companion: each nicety is its own Mod Options toggle (fail-open). Soft / Default / Hard only seed the knobs — not a forced bundle. Combat, fire, and outdoor rot stay vanilla.
WELL-KEPT APPAREL Worn clothes skip or scale the daily deterioration tick. With quality scaling on, Awful and Poor wear at the vanilla rate; Normal and above wear less; Masterwork and Legendary skip daily wear. Crafting skill can reduce wear further. Combat and fire still shred HP. Optional: clothes on a corpse keep the same rule.
THRONE AND ALTAR Royalty throne rooms may hold an Ideology altar without failing the "no altars" check. If a throne is in the room, it stays a throne room rather than flipping to a temple.
WEAR ANY OUTFIT Gender tags come off apparel so a colonist can wear the other cut of a royal vest or hat without the wrong-gender thought. Toggle restores the original tags.
HIDDEN CRYPTOSLEEP Pawns already in a cryptosleep casket drop off the colonist bar. Carrying someone to a casket does not hide them early (that is what crashed older hide-from-bar mods). They reappear when ejected.
MELEE HUNTING Hunters may hunt with a melee weapon. A body-size cap keeps people from charging a thrumbo with a knife unless you raise it. Unarmed hunting is optional and off by default.
SHARED BEDROOMS Select a bed and mark the room as shared. Extra beds stay a bedroom (not barracks), so roommates and royalty are not punished for living together. Pawns who share a room do not get the disturbed-sleep thought. Sharing one mattress with a non-partner is still vanilla. Do not run with Share Rooms [LWM] — same room-role patches.
LEAVE A WAY OUT Pawns skip finishing a wall that would trap someone or block leftover frames. They step aside before closing themselves in. Works on vanilla frames and Replace Stuff frames. In-place wall swaps stay solid so a freezer can still be replaced from inside. Right-click force construct still builds it. Do not run with Smarter Construction — same construction job.
SETTINGS Each nicety is independently on or off. Extra knobs (quality scaling, unarmed hunt, body-size cap) only apply while that nicety is on. Soft / Default / Hard change those knobs, not a forced bundle: - Soft: no daily clothing wear, corpse clothes included, unarmed hunting, any prey size. - Default: quality-scaled wear, melee up to body size 1.5, no unarmed. - Hard: no crafting bonus, melee only small game (0.8).
INCOMPATIBLE Jecs Everlasting Apparel, Allow Altars in Throneroom, Wear What You Want, Hide Cryptosleep Pawn, Share Rooms [LWM], and Smarter Construction — each overlaps one nicety. Prefer Niceties alone for those jobs.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Royalty and Ideology optional (those toggles no-op without the DLC). Chinese Simplified and Russian included. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
Inspired by ideas from Jecrell's Everlasting Apparel, Allow Altars in Throneroom, Wear What You Want, Hide Cryptosleep Pawn, Melee Hunting, Share Rooms, and Smarter Construction — rewritten from scratch for 1.6, not a continuation of those mods.
